items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Well, they had three Matthews boys at that time. Used to be Bill played, Trumbo. Remus played snare drum.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, they had three Matthews boys at that time. Used to be Bill played, Trumbo. Remus played snare drum. And his brothers, one called Turk, he used to play. Traps and snare drum, too, in the band.
Well, who was Bebe Matthews? Which one was Bebe?
